title: The Deaf man in the front row
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：deaf　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 deaf 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the fisherman wrote of ① a deaf man in the front row in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② so deaf that nobody in the harbour would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the deaf ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the deaf man in the front row that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too deaf to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the deaf ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a deaf silence from the office, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as deaf as the silence from the office they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was deaf or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something deaf, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite deaf; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the deaf ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, for the whole place, she wrote of another deaf man in the front row in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less deaf than anybody had expected. ⑩ The deaf silence from the office that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the deaf ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 耳聋（前置定语 a deaf man in the front row：1978 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件耳聋的聋人）
B. adj. 耳聋／充耳不闻（两处加强说法：so deaf that … 与 no less deaf than …）
C. adj. 耳聋／充耳不闻（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 耳聋（表语 too deaf to do：母亲觉得它太耳聋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 充耳不闻（前置定语 a deaf silence from the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩充耳不闻的毫无回应）
F. adj. 充耳不闻（同级比较 as deaf as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室的毫无回应相比）
G. adj. 充耳不闻（后置定语 something deaf：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 充耳不闻（受程度副词修饰 quite deaf：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a deaf man in the front row
the deaf man in the front row that
a deaf silence from the office
The deaf silence from the office that

answers.why: deaf 意为“耳聋”，1978 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件耳聋的聋人”，此处作前置定语 a deaf man in the front row。
deaf 意为“耳聋”，此处用 so deaf that 结构，说它耳聋到渔港里没人敢靠近。
deaf 意为“耳聋”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的耳聋前排的聋人，等于最高级的说法。
deaf 意为“耳聋”，母亲认为这件东西“太耳聋了，谁也用不上”，too deaf to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩充耳不闻的毫无回应”，此处作前置定语 a deaf silence from the office。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室的毫无回应一样充耳不闻”，同级比较用 as deaf as。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“充耳不闻的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something deaf。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当充耳不闻”，quite 修饰原级 deaf。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，no less deaf than 表示“其充耳不闻不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之充耳不闻不亚于任何人的预料。
deaf 意为“充耳不闻”，母亲 1990 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的充耳不闻毫无回应”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件耳聋的聋人。（a deaf man in the front row）
它耳聋到渔港里没有一个人敢靠近。（so deaf that …）
母亲觉得它太耳聋，谁也用不上。（too deaf to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩充耳不闻的毫无回应。（a deaf silence from the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室的毫无回应一样充耳不闻。（as deaf as …）
到了 1985 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件充耳不闻的东西。（something deaf）
answers: In 1978 the fisherman wrote of a deaf man in the front row in the logbook.
It was so deaf that nobody in the harbour would go near it.
My mother thought it too deaf to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a deaf silence from the office.
He said nobody would call it as deaf as the silence from the office they had once had.
By 1985 the logbook asked for nothing but something deaf.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 deaf 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the fisherman wrote of a deaf man in the front row in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the deaf man in the front row that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too deaf to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a deaf silence from the office, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite deaf, and everybody laughed.
The deaf ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
